title: Harden aesthetic hide protections for price and accessibility
desired_change: Make Deck Grammar aesthetic guardrails and QDG-005 reject any attempt to hide evidence, uncertainty, authority, risk, price, or accessibility, and require those six fields in aesthetic-contract.schema.json.
expected_outcome: Aesthetic contracts cannot launder consequential information out of reviewable Hands or generated surfaces.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Without this hardening, aesthetics could hide price or accessibility while still passing adversarial fixtures.

hidden_context_dependencies: Checklist language is stricter than the original candidate guard set.
acceptance_checks: Guard rejects must_hide containing price or accessibility.
Aesthetic schema requires the six checklist fields in must_not_hide.
resolution_note: Implemented on the issue #26 evaluation branch as part of the revise recommendation.
